title: Sinsk extinction event
summary: About 513.5 million years ago, early in Cambrian Stage 4, marine life suffered a sharp extinction named after the Sinsk Formation of the Siberian Platform. Reef-building archaeocyath sponges and many small shelly animals were hit hardest, while brachiopods and trilobites fared better. Studies estimate 45 to over 60 percent loss, and causes are debated.
